verdict.rationale: GitHub's first-party docs say the REST API is versioned with date-based version names, and clients can pick a version per request. Breaking changes ship only in a new API version with advance notice, which is the core of a documented deprecation policy; stable OpenAPI descriptions back this up. Missing for 10: explicit support window for older API versions, GraphQL API deprecation/versioning policy, independent or hands-on corroboration.
